title: Independently certify #4532's finite figures: abstract witness, counterexample, p7/p16 root applications (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/gate-existence-check/`. It is an independent certified recomputation of the finite figures in dillona's #4532 (adaptive gates at a moment crossing), the compiler that #4535's κ = 0.003020165 rests on.

**Claim type:** an independent certified recomputation. **No new κ.**

## Results

All of #4532's tables reproduce.

- **Abstract witness** (`T(1/2) = P(1/2) = 68`): mean gap 4.765 ≥ 4; `U = 0.6223559 < .622356`; `V = 0.6603487 < .660349`; mirror 0.010664 ≤ 1/80 < capacity 1/32; tangent cover holds; **recurrence bound 272.8579195 > 272.857919**, against the required 155/3.
- **Counterexample.** `T(1/2 − λ)e^{λμ_P} = 8 + 136·16^{−λ} > 8 = P(1/2)` for every `λ > 0`, and the mirror ratio is exactly 1/17 < 1/16.
- **Root applications:**

  | | gap | mirror | capacity | D | required |
  | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
  | p7 | 1.723542 | .320851 | .984544 | .028590 | .023329 |
  | p16 | 1.042285 | .562814 | .982102 | .048546 | .042808 |

  The guards also hold on the critical covers.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gate-existence-check --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gate-existence-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/gate-existence-check outcome=completed   (~25 s, stdlib only)
```

Head: `530a5b6d2ae7ee0a1eccc88975a170cf39b60b94`. Base: canonical main `f9f85c1e`.

## Not covered

- #4532's theorem itself: the integral identities, the existence argument and the critical-endpoint majorant.
